title: Crăciun la Brașov
description: Christmas evening by a crackling fireplace in a Romanian home, with snowy Brașov, the Tâmpa and the Black Church through the window, and a "Crăciun fericit" card on the mantel. Warm fire, walnut and cream, serif type.

evidence.summary: Craciun 1.2.0 source and ordinary distribution hashes validated. Both Root and No-root browser previews apply the package, retain app order and decode its still video at 3840x2160. All card previews load; cards show 4K and 3.1 MB with no motion icon. Original CSS, preview and JPEG fallback are byte-identical to author 1.1.0. AI-generated 1672x941 source was upscaled by the author, not native UHD detail. Physical production package, Home routing, sound, power and OTA are not tested by these browser checks.
